scope: Metadata-only original packet presentation-time binding for the single already completed decode. No image decoding or extraction in this audit.
method: Parse H.264 SPS/PPS and each original MP4 packet slice header; one picture per packet. Sort each IDR epoch by explicitly read picture order count (POC). Every epoch has unique contiguous POC 0..N-1, N<=29, below half the 64-value POC modulus (no wrap). Match all 259 ordered picture types and keyframe flags against the pre-selection decoder showinfo sequence. Keep original packet PTS, DTS, original byte positions/hashes and decoder-selected timestamps separately.
